lines.text: You hear three languages in as many steps, and nobody seems to find it strange.
People here greet newcomers with open curiosity, and ask where you have come from before your name.
A cook at a doorway mixes the spices of two different homelands into one pot.
Neighbours bargain in a trade tongue that belongs to no one and works for everyone.
